items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Well he and I hit it off right away. We got to be good friends.

ctx.x: One thing that just occurred to me. How did you get your nickname?

Cozy? In high school. See, I love athletics, the hundred-yard dash, pole vaulting, broad jumping, football, baseball and basketball, but I just loved football. Well, in high school, you become acquainted with different people in other high schools. So this friend of mine was in another high school in Red Bank. His name was B. Z. Runyon, big guy. You know how kids always attach a nickname to somebody who's big. Well we used to call him Beanzy Runyon. Well he and I hit it off right away. We got to be good friends.…

to look up at that line and saw Beanzy coming. And Beanzy is big period. And with all that regalia on, the shoulder pads and all that, he looked like a mountain coming after you. So Beanzy knew every step that I was going to take and I knew that. But he tackled me but not hard. It was afterwards, that scrimmage, all on top of you. Anyway he tackled me and he dislocated my shoulder and they had to carry me off the field, they brought a stretcher on there, and they had to carry me off the field. So from that day…
